_comment: Data-integrity rules for the data-quality layer (prism_ml.data.quality). These protect against faulty or stale inputs; they are NOT the thermal-status classifier and never output Good / Needs Attention / High Risk. Values are operational settings derived from the firmware's 10-second push interval and the sensor datasheet ranges; review them after calibration.
thermal_min_std_note: A frame whose 64 pixels are (almost) identical indicates a disconnected, covered or frozen sensor.
water_low_note: Mirrors the firmware's computeWaterStatus() 'Low' band (<25 %). Used only to add a water-availability sentence.
